info.name: GigCraft API
info.description: Generated from server/docs/endpoints.js. Log in first; Postman stores the auth cookie. Ids are saved into collection variables automatically.

request.description:
Server health check

Access: Public

Create an account and sign in (sets the httpOnly cookie)

Access: Public

Access: Public

Clear the auth cookie

Access: Public

Current user (used to restore the session)

Access: Logged in

Request a reset link (printed in the server console in this project)

Access: Public

Set a new password using the token from the reset link

Access: Public

All categories with published gig counts

Access: Public

exec: let json = {}; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
{ const v = "categories.0._id".split(".").reduce((o, k) => (o ? o[k] : undefined), json); if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("categoryId", v); }

request.description:
Search, filter, sort and paginate published gigs (server-side)

{ const v = "gigs.0.seller._id".split(".").reduce((o, k) => (o ? o[k] : undefined), json); if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("freelancerId", v); }
